caption:
Stock market news | Brent crude crosses $96 barrel after Houthis attack

On 27 November 2026 Brent crude moved above $96 a barrel after the Houthis attacked a key Saudi refinery.

Despite the attack, Vortexa reports higher November traffic through the Strait of Hormuz and the IEA expects a quarterly oil surplus, which has kept prices from rising further.
